Other network providers</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Outpatient visits to a network physician are paid in full after a $15 co-payment, except as noted in Section 11.B.2.*</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services of network providers are paid in full (after any applicable co-payment) except when provided for the treatment of substance abuse, mental illness, or TMJ/MPDS.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Other covered services of network providers are paid at ninety-five percent (95%) of the allowed charge, except when provided for outpatient mental illness, preventive care, smoking cessation, or the treatment of TMJ/MPDS.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>3. Non-network providers</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">a. Physicians, hospitals and other covered health care providers in a license category eligible to participate in the network</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services of non-network providers are paid at sixty percent (60%) of usual and customary charges in a location where there are network providers qualified to provide medically necessary services.*</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>&lt;ecel&gt;</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td></tr></table>

This payment level does not apply to preventive care, smoking cessation, vision care, or the treatment of mental illness, substance abuse, or TMJ/MPDS.
